tasks.functional_overlap: Undirected implementation pair; specified shared behavior, not automatic merge eligibility
tasks.responsibility_boundary: Directed implementation-to-owner claim with independent architecture evidence

input_identity: Each case ID must resolve to pinned source ranges and configuration in its evidence; label scope is the dataset task only
discovery: retrieved is an unordered, duplicate-free set of case IDs; ranking must be an explicit permutation, never inferred from file order
budget: Top-k candidate judgments per task; CPU, extraction coverage, model cost and runtime separately reported
confirmation: One positive/negative/abstain decision for every selected case; positive means the declared task relation, never safe optimization

metrics.candidate_known_positive_recall: retrieved known positives / all known positives in the frozen reference population; null when no positives
metrics.top_k_known_positive_recall: top-k known positives / all reference known positives
metrics.top_k_relevance_bounds: [positive/n, (positive+unknown)/n]; null for empty output; not confidence intervals
metrics.judged_precision: positive/(positive+negative) within top-k; null if no judged labels; not whole-output precision
metrics.judgment_coverage: (positive+negative)/n within top-k; null for empty output
metrics.confirmation: confusion counts only for judged selected cases; abstention and predictions on unknown labels separately counted

guards: No global recall with incomplete or output-selected reference labels
No conversion of review disposition, test pass or merged PR into positive labels
No mixed tasks in a single aggregate score
No origin/family overlap across development and test splits
No post-change docs or patch explanation as pre-change detector input
No optimization claims from overlap or responsibility labels
Exclude unresolvable source/configuration from scored population with explicit counts; do not silently drop

next_collection.development: Reuse existing xkernel findings as hypotheses and hard-case sources, not independent labels
next_collection.controlled: Pair rename/equivalent mechanism with changed side effect, existing delegation, cfg alternatives and stale/misleading documentation controls
next_collection.external: Freeze unrelated Rust projects and provenance before test use; shared upstream ancestry is one split group
next_collection.history: Record pre-change source, accepted/refused/reverted outcome and dimension-specific rationale separately
next_collection.release_gate: Independent adjudication and benchmark protocol compatibility before effectiveness claims
